# Boltara Scaling

> End-to-end client acquisition for surface prep and coating contractors. We run the ads, follow up fast, and book paying jobs straight to your calendar.

Boltara Scaling LLC is a niche marketing and lead generation agency serving sandblasting shops, powder coating shops, and surface preparation contractors across the United States. Founded by Tim Sebolt. We build and operate the full client acquisition pipeline — targeted Meta ads, automated CRM follow-up, lead qualification, and pre-booked appointments — so contractors focus on the work, not the marketing.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://boltarascaling.com/): Main site. Covers the core offer, a real client case study (Show Me Mobile Blasting), the 4-part system (ads, automated follow-up, booked appointments, live dashboard), the onboarding process, about, FAQ, and booking.
- [Privacy Policy](https://boltarascaling.com/privacy-policy.html): Data collection and usage policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://boltarascaling.com/terms.html): Terms governing use of the site and services.
- [Booking Confirmation](https://boltarascaling.com/confirmed-thank-you.html): Post-appointment booking confirmation page.

## What We Do

Boltara Scaling runs the complete lead pipeline for surface prep and coating contractors:

1. **Targeted ads** — Meta/Facebook campaigns built for specific service areas, not generic templates. Video and image ads pre-qualify leads by job type and budget.
2. **Automated follow-up** — Every inquiry is answered immediately via CRM automation (GoHighLevel), 24/7, including nights and weekends.
3. **Booked appointments** — Leads are qualified and scheduled directly to the contractor's calendar. No chasing, no cold leads sitting in an inbox.
4. **Live dashboard** — Contractors see cost per lead, show rate, jobs booked, and revenue attributed in real time.

## Niche

Surface preparation and coating industry: sandblasting, media blasting, powder coating, wet blasting, industrial coating. Serves both mobile operators and fixed-location shops. U.S.-based clients only.
